page.overview:
What is Elfheim?

Elfheim, also known as Elfland, is a town in the original Final Fantasy. Located southwest of Cornelia, it is the home of the elves. The Elven Castle is located directly above the town.

The prince of the elves is put into a deep sleep by Astos, the king of the dark elves, to steal the kingdom's treasure. The kingdom of Elfheim asks the Warriors of Light for their help to defeat Astos. After they defeat Astos at the Western Keep and get a potion from Matoya to awaken the prince, he responds by giving them the mystic key, allowing them to get the explosives from Cornelia Castle to give to the dwarves.

Some of the elves in Elfheim can talk about airships built by an ancient race. There are two differently clothed elves in town who are training on their foresight and ask the party to come to them in a later time. Once the party obtains a levistone, one of them will talk about the location on where one can find the stone while another talks about the area where the stone should be used to obtain an airship beneath the sand.
